applies_to: Every active ASX equity (universe.security_kind = 'au_equity', is_active) with a usable point-in-time fundamentals row: residual-income valuation on reported book equity, run weekly by jobs/run_valuation.py. Supersedes prereg-au-majors-2026-09-08 (tangible common equity, four names) for the universe-wide run; the Phase 1 levers and probabilities are carried unchanged.

levers.label: bear
levers.rationale: Carried from prereg-au-majors-2026-09-08: a downturn of the depth the Australian majors reached in FY20-FY22, short of a NAB-FY16-style write-off year. Empirically 9.6% of the observed name-years were at or below this level; 25% is the deliberately conservative assignment and is not to be revised because a resulting value looks low.

levers.label: base
levers.rationale: The name's own trailing-twelve-month ROE from rs_fundamentals_pit, carried as the starting point of the linear fade to Ke. No forecast is applied.

levers.label: bull
levers.rationale: Carried from prereg-au-majors-2026-09-08: a return toward the 2013-2015 profitability band. Empirically 21.2% of the observed name-years were at or above this level.

sensitivities.label: average_roe
sensitivities.parameter: base scenario re-run with roe_start = the mean ROE of the latest 3 point-in-time periods (fewer when fewer exist); zero-excess; Ke mid
sensitivities.rationale: Trailing ROE at a cycle peak is the model's largest single distortion (baseline 2026-09-16: Metro Mining 94x value/price on trailing ROE, 0.92x on the 3-period average). The discovery ranker (S4) uses the LOWER of the registered value and this one; it never replaces the registered value.

sensitivities.label: fading_excess_w050
sensitivities.parameter: persistence w = 0.5 (Ohlson): ROE fades to Ke + 0.5 * (ROE_0 - Ke) and the surviving excess decays at 0.5 forever; probability-weighted; Ke mid
sensitivities.rationale: The comparison convention required by the standing pre-commitment: computed universe-wide ALONGSIDE zero_excess so the calibration metric (share of names valued above market) becomes interpretable. Illustrative; no operative persistence value has been pre-registered for use in a thesis.

sensitivities.label: unadjusted_franking
sensitivities.parameter: the registered probability-weighted value at Ke mid with franking_pct = None (pre_tax_no_franking_adjustment)
sensitivities.rationale: The adjustment is worth roughly a fifth of value on a fully franked payer and rests on investor residency, so both figures are published side by side (Phase 1 practice).

ke_treatment.beta_provenance: third-party five-year estimates (Finbox, Simply Wall St, Yahoo Finance) for the four Australian majors; reviewed 2026-09-08; CITED, not measured from asxos price data; applied universe-wide because beta cannot be measured (AXJO.INDX holds fewer than 250 sessions, backlog E-19)
ke_treatment.risk_free_series: FRED IRLTLT01AUM156N via market_context_current.aus_10y_yield (OECD monthly long-term government bond yield for Australia, carried forward)
ke_treatment.sensitivity_note: Ke is NOT a scenario lever. Ke uncertainty is carried by the stated beta band (value at Ke low / mid / high on every row). Scenario uncertainty is the ROE path only. Keeping them separate is what stops the two mechanisms double-counting.

input_rules.universe: universe WHERE security_kind = 'au_equity' AND is_active; ETFs, LICs-by-kind and hybrids are not valued (no book/ROE basis)
input_rules.pit_selection: rs_fundamentals_pit: the latest usable row per symbol with knowledge_date <= cutoff date, ordered by as_of DESC then knowledge_date DESC; roe_average = mean(roe) over the latest 3 such rows with non-null roe
input_rules.usd_conversion: book_value_ps and dividend_ttm of a USD reporter (rs_fundamentals_pit.currency = 'USD') are divided by the fx_rates AUDUSD rate on or before the cutoff date; AUD reporters are taken as is
input_rules.currency_unverified_policy: a NULL or blank rs_fundamentals_pit.currency is VALUED as AUD and FLAGGED currency_unverified (currency_verified = false), never hidden — backlog C-20 closes the flag; any other currency blocks with currency_unconvertible
input_rules.payout_rule: payout_ratio = dividend_ttm / eps_ttm clipped to [0, 1]; 0 when eps_ttm <= 0 or dividend_ttm is NULL; clipping is recorded (payout_clipped)
input_rules.franking_rule: franking_pct = rs_fundamentals_pit.franking_avg_pct as reported, 0 where absent; grossed up at 30/70 for an Australian resident holder

evidence_basis: prereg-au-majors-2026-09-08 (rs_fundamentals_pit.roe, CBA/NAB/ANZ/WBC, 52 name-years from 2013: each year's ROE over the name's own 13-year mean ranged 0.072 to 1.427; 9.6% at or below 0.70, 21.2% at or above 1.20) and the 2026-09-16 baseline inquiry (docs/proposals/baseline-inquiry-2026-09-16.md; scripts/research/baseline_inquiry.sql REPORT B, parity <= 0.000001 to value_per_share on five names).
pre_commitment: Ruled by James 2026-09-08 and carried here before the first universe run: if this method values a name materially below its market price, NO horizon extension, NO growth term and NO terminal excess return will be added to close the gap. A method revision is an ADR decision made on queue-wide evidence, never on one name. The fading-excess figure is recorded as a sensitivity for that queue-wide comparison and is not a basis for any value, thesis or ranking.
